criteria.contract: Explicit v13 permits a local head to agree bounded household procurement with a willing adult direct retainer; actor/capacity/authority/cash/monthly budget checked without automating player travel
The retainer uses common land journeys to source and home, buys only on actual arrival with actual stock and entrusted cash, returns unused cash and cargo once; no teleportation or resource creation

Source shortage, closed roads, expiry and service/authority loss preserve entrusted assets and return obligations; busy carriers cannot accept overlapping tasks; after settlement another bounded job can be agreed
Player view distinguishes known dispatch from local returned receipt, conceals remote current purchase/stock/cash and allows no remote cancellation effect or arbitrary NPC impersonation
Normal entry/UI and saved recovery/future equality, legacy v12 bytes, Game build and headless 3D placement are verified with honest GUI/full-suite limits

limits: Bounded local head/direct-retainer procurement and return, not generic autonomous merchants or forward battlefield convoys. No remote cancellation or route handover. Road blocking tested with real travel; expiry derived-fold tested, not a30-day NPC journey; actual NPC service/house loss is not separately exercised. GUI/full-suite NOT_RUN.
